newsitem.title: UK: McCarthy & Stone positive on current year.
newsitem.headline: McCarthy & Stone positive on current year.

text.p: Property development firm McCarthy & Stone said on Tuesday that it began its current financial year positively, with first time visitors and net reservations up 30 percent in four months to December 31, 1996.
"The improving market conditions are reaching out from the south east across the rest of the country," chairman John MacCarthy told the company's annual meeting.
The share price of the firm firmed 5-1/2 pence to 114 in a moderate trading volume of 1.09 million shares after his comments.
"We are continuing to contain building costs and we are securing adequate land opportunities," McCarthy said.
He said the budget in November did not appear to have an adverse impact on the market as it had on some occasions in the past.
"Barring any slowdown with the political environment may create in the current financial year, I continue to be confident of our ability to make significant progress," he said.
